parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log delivery configuration to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的外发投递配置名称
parameters.name: delivery_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the log delivery configuration to modify. Valid values:

syslog: delivers logs to a syslog service.
kafka: delivers logs to a Kafka service
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的外发投递配置类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发到kafka服务
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en:
The log delivery configuration content, which is a string converted from a JSON object constructed with a series of parameters.

This parameter is the same as the DeliveryDetail parameter of the CreateLogDeliveryConfig operation. For more information, see the log delivery configuration content parameter description in the [CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
外发投递配置内容，以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。

与CreateLogDeliveryConfig接口的DeliveryDetail参数相同。相关描述，请参见[CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~)接口的外发投递配置内容参数描述
parameters.name: delivery_detail

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
